bear-red.$description: Bear Red — Logo mark, link color, Pro badge fill, decorative underline on hero copy — the single chromatic voice in an otherwise achromatic system

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Icon fills, graphic strokes, max-contrast emphasis

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary body and heading text, nav links — the dominant typographic color across the entire page

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted body text, secondary labels, icon strokes

stone-border.$description: Stone Border — Hairline borders on inputs, dividers, card edges

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle fills, decorative stroke elements, pricing card backgrounds

mist.$description: Mist — Page sections, soft surface lifts, alternating band backgrounds

linen-white.$description: Linen White — Page canvas, card surfaces, input backgrounds, nav background

marker-lime.$description: Marker Lime — Highlight wash behind emphasized words (like a real highlighter stroke on text)

tag-indigo.$description: Tag Indigo — Note tag color in product preview, heading accent variant

tag-forest.$description: Tag Forest — Note tag color in product preview, heading accent variant

tag-plum.$description: Tag Plum — Note tag color in product preview, heading accent variant

warning-amber.$description: Warning Amber — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

info-sky.$description: Info Sky — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

bearsans.$description: Body text, navigation, buttons, pricing lists, inputs, footnotes. Weight 700 is reserved for emphasis (feature names, Pro plan title); weight 400 carries everything else. Carries a uniform +0.031em tracking that gives the body a slightly airy, typeset feel.

bearsansheadline.$description: Display headlines only — the singular 400 weight is the signature: no bold marketing-shout headlines, just quiet, confident regular weight at 42–51px. Creates the 'handwritten note on good paper' mood.
